data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 27/2045Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: NOAA HURRICANE HUNTERS FIND THAT POLO REMAINS A CATEGORY 3 HURRICANE. ...HURRICANE AND TROPICAL STORM WARNINGS ISSUED FOR MAINLAND MEXICO ALONG THE GULF OF CALIFORNIA COAST... As of 2:00 PM MST Sun Sep 27 the center of Polo was located near 21.9, -114.1 with movement N at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 951 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 125 mph.

data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Odalys (EP1), advisory 27/2037Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: ODALYS IS NOW A POST-TROPICAL CYCLONE. ...THIS IS THE LAST ADVISORY... As of 2:00 PM PDT Sun Sep 27 the center of Odalys was located near 22.8, -123.1 with movement NNE at 6 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1000 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 27/2037Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY BARELY A TROPICAL CYCLONE. As of 9:00 PM GMT Sun Sep 27 the center of Fay was located near 28.9, -44.0 with movement S at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1011 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 27/2036Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: DEPRESSION STRENGTHENS INTO A TROPICAL STORM. As of 3:00 PM CST Sun Sep 27 the center of Rachel was located near 12.6, -99.1 with movement WNW at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1005 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.
